El Corral – Local Favorite in Copperas Cove 🌮 | i35 Group Neighborhood Spotlight #smallbusiness 

Looking for great local eats in Copperas Cove? Join us as we stop by El Corral, a locally loved restaurant known for its cozy atmosphere, sizzling fajitas, and of course—chips and salsa that never disappoint.

In this quick tour, you’ll see:
✅ The outdoor patio that’s perfect for sunny days
✅ Their classic Tex-Mex menu favorites
✅ A fajita plate with all the fixings (rice, beans, tortillas—you name it!)
✅ Why locals keep coming back for more

At i35 Group, we’re more than just real estate agents—we’re neighborhood experts. We love highlighting local businesses that make Central Texas feel like home.

If you’re thinking about moving to Copperas Cove or the surrounding area, we’d love to help you find your perfect home while connecting you with the places locals love most.
